description: Gets an idea, criticism or comment on Veritula by its number (#123 on the site): its full text in Markdown, whether it's rationally adoptable, what it replies to, and the replies it got: its pending criticisms (the ones that keep it from being rationally adoptable), the criticisms that have been addressed by pending criticisms of their own, and neutral comments. Replies are given in brief; get them in full by their numbers.
name: get_idea
title: Get an idea
